strings.en: You're not getting away!
Now all that's left is to put it into action!
Leave that enemy to me!
I'll show you results!
I'm taking the first move!
Now, let's see if you can do/　something I didn't predict!
I'm not holding back!
The predictions are in... Now all that's left is...!
I'm a member of the Instructors too, you know!
Don't let your guard down, Aqua!
Yes, I know!
Here we go, Hugo!
It's all yours!
Leave this to me!
Right! Don't miss your shot!
I'm ready whenever you are!
Alriiight! Here we go, then!
Our turn!
I'll give you a painful blow!
I have to make sure to record/　the commander unit's data...!
Jua-Mu, I'll stop you right here!
If I can just take down the commander...!
I'm your opponent, Al-Van!
Even with data, you can't let/　your guard down against a Raftclans!
Here I come, Fu-Ruu!
The black Raftclans... I'm going in!
Karo-Ran! Whatever you're scheming, it's useless!
The Emperor Unit Zee-Gadin.../　So that's that man's trump card...!
Neither the throne nor Her Highness/　will ever be yours!
Whatever their goal is...!
I should collect plenty of data on them...!
Better back off before you draw the short straw!
Whoever the pilot is, if we have/　data on the machine...!
I won't let you have your way, Iradoya!
Gomoudokka! Keep your hands off Earth!
If that man is the one behind it all...!
I won't let you interfere, Reggiane!
Letting that man use the Cross Gate/　is way too dangerous!
Possessed by his own lust for research.../　It's just like...!
If we don't hurry, the operation...!
We're coming through, Gadisword!
Dark Brain... I heard it was a tough enemy,/　and he's one of its remnants!
What are you scheming by capturing Kaana types?!
Debudedabide... Even if you're hard to predict!
Controlling anything it pleases... What a pain!
I can't let it keep controlling army machines!
I've fought those machines plenty of times!
I wonder how much good the data/　will do against Madnet...!
Get ready, Crystal Dragoon!
Target: Skull Knight! Commencing attack!
You're nothing but a runaway machine,/　XN-L!
We're meant to be destroyed? Don't make me laugh!
I'll defeat you right here, XN-L!
If you're going to deny life,/　then I'll deny your existence!
Target: Zovorg unit!
I've seen right through that unit's/　behavior patterns!
Get ready, Golaikunru!
I won't let the Golaikunru have our technology!
You people just don't give up!
An eye for an eye! I won't lose/　a long-range firefight either!
Mass-produced or not, I have to watch out/　for that machine...!
You won't get to those two!
I have the commander unit's data,/　but I can't let my guard down!
High-performance multirole unit or not!
Zeranio-class acquired, commencing attack!
If I can predict the line of fire!
It doesn't look much like earlier models, but...
That movement... it wavers in a way/　bioroids don't?
Target: Thick Cylinder, locked!
Target: Thick Cylinder! Commencing attack!
Once I seal off that cannon, it's all mine!
Leave the Big Shoulder to me!
Here I come, White Horn!
We'll handle the horned one!
Target: Thorn! Here I go!
We can't give the Thorn an opening!
I won't let it near the mothership!
As long as I predict its evasion,/　high mobility won't matter!
That new model seems to have/　some serious thrust...!
That speed... I have to lock on right!
Target: Cupid! I'll hold it back!
Target: Gasbra! Commencing attack!
Vengeful ghost or whatever, I can't ignore it!
Lamaris acquired! Attacking!
We have to thin out the Lamaris!
I'll predict even the Lamaris's moves!
I'm going after that Lamaris!
Go carefully, Aqua!
Fusion... So that's one of their traits!
It's getting even creepier... but I can't/　let that stop me!
Target: Lamaris Kaana!
I'd better watch out for the Lamaris Kaana...!
You don't scare me, Lamaris Kaana!
A giant Lamaris... Before it gets out of hand!
An Ida type... I have to take it down fast!
If I apply our combat data/　against the Ares Geist...!
I'll keep the Ares Geist in check!
I won't let them use the Ares Geist/　any further!
I'll just have to put up with the gross!
Here I come, Yokijin!
Now it's my turn!
That last one showed me/　your attack pattern!
Don't think you can run!
Just give up already!
I'm a step behind, but.../　I'll still get results!
You should've predicted the counterattack too!
You're not getting away!
I've been waiting for this moment!
Kyaaaaah!!
Damn it! Is this the end?!
Oh no! Frame damage!?
...At least I avoided a direct/　hit to the generator...!
I-I have to read its movements...!!
Ahh! A direct hit!?
I've come this far.../　I'm not going down now...!
Cutting power to damaged sections.../　Rebalancing... There!
S-Stay calm, analyze the situation.../　and handle whatever comes...!
C-Cerberus can't take/　much more of this...!!
Aaaah! A-At this rate...!!
Don't flinch! Attack!!
I-Is it time to brace for the worst...?!
Not yet! Don't you dare give up!
Please, hold on, Garmraid!!
J-Jua-Mu, I'm not down yet...!
I-It surpasses the data/　on every Fury machine...!
Don't think you've won, Gomoudokka!
A direct hit...! If that scythe hits me again...!
Unless we cut the Floraga off/　from the Cross Gate...!
I-I can't get shot down by a clown like that...!
The Crystal Dragoon is overpowering me...?!
Skull Knight! This isn't decided yet!
XN-L! I won't let you go any further!
I-I can't keep up with the Zovorg machine...!
Ngh! If I go down first...!
Ngh! Checking damage.../　Still okay!
Hey! That's no way to treat a lady!
If you think I'm backing down,/　you're dead wrong!
Ngh! Did the waist gear slip!?
It didn't reach the frame! I can manage!
Thruster burn wasn't long enough...!
With damage control, I can keep going!
I can recover from/　this much damage!
I didn't think I was relying on the data too much...!
Ngh! Cerberus's response is...!
Ugh...! It hit us dead-on!
Now we're paying them back double!!
As long as the unit moves, we can manage!/　No, I'll make sure we do!
Sorry, that was careless of me...!
Never mind. Think about what's next.
It's okay, Garmraid can still move!
Jua-Mu, this isn't over!
Ngh, you're good, Al-Van!
I'll read you next time, Fu-Ruu!
Karo-Ran... He's spotted my blind spots...!
It really lives up to the name Emperor Unit...!
I-I can't dodge an attack like that!
I'm not beaten yet, Gomoudokka!
To be able to master/　the Cross Gate's energy...!
Debudedabide...! What is with that guy?!
I won't show the Crystal Dragoon/　any more openings...!
Skull Knight, just you wait!
I won't end it like this!
Yeah! Make them regret laying a hand on us!
Has that Zovorg machine been upgraded?!
Seems even the Fury vary in skill...!
I-I can't dodge the Ida type's attacks!
Its movements are hard to predict...!
No way! I misread it!?
Guess my calculations were off...!
Guess I've still got a ways to go...
This was all part of the plan/　...let's just go with that.
Wh-What? I got hit!?
Ngh! I need more distance!
Like this is enough to scare me!
Motor RPM's still up! I can do this!
Gotta stabilize output and balance...!
Oops. I still have a lot to learn in real combat.
Oh no!/　Cerberus got scratched!
To think you'd catch up to Cerberus!
S-Sorry! It grazed me!
Don't worry about me./　Focus on the fight.
Are the unit's reactions a bit slow...?!
I'll give my opponent credit for that./　But next time, I'll see it coming!
Are you all right!?
Y-Yeah... No need to worry.
Ngh! Well done landing a hit on us!
You'll pay for this later, you know?
Sorry, Garmraid...!
How dare you, Jua-Mu!
Al-Van's reach is wider than I thought...!
Fu-Ruu, so this was what you were aiming for?!
Half-hearted moves won't work on Karo-Ran...!
Zee-Gadin.../　I doubt this is all it's got...!
Have your fun while you can, Gomoudokka!
The Siebe Drive's output adjustment/　isn't working...?!
You sure know how to surprise me, Debudedabide!
Skull Knight outsmarted me...!
Are your fine slogans all you've got, XN-L?!
One hit isn't going to keep me down!
That's the spirit! Pay them back right away!
Just as its behavior patterns said,/　it came right to me!
I meant to slip through that barrage!
A cut above mass-produced units...!
Th-That thing's fast...!
Not bad, Fury!
Thorn, I'll get as much data on you as I can!
I can't let a Kaana type give me trouble...!
We have to stop the Ares Geist here...!
Ugh, I couldn't shake off the Yokijin...!
Your aim is sloppy!
As if you'll hit me that easily!
Just the attack I predicted!
Something like that won't hit me!
You picked the wrong target!
I can handle any move you make!
So-Des, you fell for it completely.
You can't hit me, Jua-Mu!
I won't let you, Al-Van!
I've already analyzed/　the Raftclans's patterns!
Looks like I read you better, Karo-Ran!
It doesn't seem as fast as a Raftclans, but...!
Too much curiosity can be a problem!
I can't take the Cross Gate's energy/　head-on!
I refuse to accept magic without dreams!
Joining the skeletons? No thanks!
XN-L, notice the contradiction in your actions!
Even when they're controlled,/　I can predict the patterns!
A pattern I've already got down is a breeze!
The firing intervals are just as predicted!
I'll dodge even the Thorn's attacks!
I won't be beaten by Lamaris!
I can't let the Lamaris Kaana catch me!
I'll handle the Ida types properly too!
Hey! Don't get so close!
As if I'd lose to a Yokijin!
I dodged it!
Keep this up and I've got it!
It's not like I have the power/　of foresight, you know?
That was a little close.../　but all's well that ends well!
If I do say so myself, that was a nice dodge!
Nice, Aqua!
Heh,/　see? I'm not all talk!
Whoa, that was close!
It's fine, it's fine!/　Just watch me!
Thought you hit me? Too bad!
Looks like I won't be needed...
Stay sharp, here comes the next one!
OK! Leave it to me!!
How was that evasion pattern, Hugo?
Yeah, it's usable.
I have to watch out for that type's next move...!
The combat data from the other Gyanonia paid off!
If it were an ornament, it'd at least be cuter!
I won't let that thing near me!
Ares Geist... Without the prediction data,/　that would've been close...!
Shield!
Rowga! Protect me!
Please, Rowga!!
W-we still feel the shock...!
Better than taking a direct hit!
Useless!
You underestimated our defenses!
TE Sphere!!
As if I'd take a hit like that!
Well, the guard on this thing is solid...
TE Sphere, deploy!
Too bad!
Always be prepared!
Just as I thought, missiles!
Well? Surprised?!
There's more than one way to do this!
Output's dropping! We can't counter!
Ngh, no way to counter!
Calm down! I'll think of something!
How careless of me.../　Misjudging the relative distance!
Ngh, so fast...! Where did it go?!
Sorry, I lost it!
I'll catch it right away!
I can still go...! Moving to support!
You failed to pull away...!/　Sorry, but here I come!
Just as planned! I can still attack!
Let's use a combination here!
Major Kai, I'll support you!
Watch me, Major! I'm going too!
Major, leave the rest to me!
Teaming up with a member of the/　legendary Instruction Team... An honor!
Lieutenant Lamia, I'll back you up!
Radha, leave the rest to me!
Latune, I'll back you up!
Arado, leave the rest to me!
I'll back you up, Seolla!
Josh, leave the rest to me!
I'll lend a hand, Rim!
I'll back you up, Arieil!
Team ATX! I'll back you up!
Ing, I'll cover you!
Lieutenant Kyosuke, leave the rest to me!
Team SRX! I'll back you up!
Touya, I'll back you up!
Following Lieutenant Calvina!
Akimi, leave the rest to me!
Akemi, I'll back you up!
We can strike too!
Right, let's finish this!
Look out!!
My unit can take it!
Don't think it'll be that easy!
Attacking isn't the only tactic, you know!
Major Kai, pull back!
Major Kai, look out!
I won't let you hurt the man I admire!
Major, please fall back!
Lieutenant Lamia, pull out!
Radha, leave this to me!
Fall back, Latune!
Arado, don't be reckless!
Seolla, get back!
Get out of there, Josh!
Rim, leave this to me!
Arieil, fall back!
Get out of there, Ing!
Touya, get out of there!
Lieutenant Calvina, fall back!
Akimi, pull back!
Akemi, leave this to me!
Now! Cut in!!
Right! I'll protect them!!
I can still fight!
One more strike!
This seals it!
Here comes the second move, right after!
You're mine!
Take this!
There!
Raygun Pod, deploy! Go!!
Pods out! Commencing attack!
Target locked! Commencing attack!
I'll hit you, just watch!
You're in range! I'm firing!
Go down!
Barrel, deploy!
Charge complete!
Terminus Smasher, fire!!
Terminus Smasher! Gooo!!
Barrel, right, left!
Top, set!
Lock!
Deploy!
Target locked on!
TE Engine, Over Blue!
Fire, Aqua!
Right!
Kerbereid Busteeeer!!
Now, Aqua!
Roger!
Kerbereid Buster, fire!!
Bloody Ray!!
Bloody Ray, fire!!
Bloody! Raaaay!!
Fang Knuckle!!
Take this!/　Fang Knuckle!!
Fang Knuckle! Go get 'em!!
TE Sphere...
Radiate!
Haaah!
Terminus Shot!!
MA Parts, purge!
Go, Hiou!
Rouga!
Now! Spin Raid!
Spin Raid! Attack!!
TE Sphere, radiate!
Ignition!!
This ends it!
Trinity Dead Ennnd!!
Now, brace yourself!!
Trinity Dead End!!
